Sandbox_HWE_EnableEvent_tooltip: Master switch for the Halloween event.
Sandbox_HWE_UseCalendarTrigger_tooltip: Automatically start and end the event on the configured in-game dates.
Sandbox_HWE_EnableDebugMenu_tooltip: Adds event testing controls under Debug > HWE in the context menu. Multiplayer server permissions still apply.
Sandbox_HWE_EnableDebugLogging_tooltip: Off by default. When enabled, prints Halloween costume spawning, native outfit, loot and client sync diagnostics to the console. Important error messages remain visible when disabled.
Sandbox_HWE_StartSchedule_tooltip: In-game start date and time. Use MM/DD HH:MM, for example 10/15 00:00.
Sandbox_HWE_EndSchedule_tooltip: In-game end date and time. Use MM/DD HH:MM, for example 10/31 23:59.
Sandbox_HWE_CostumeChancePercent_tooltip: Chance for an eligible loaded zombie to receive a costume when the event activates. Reroll ignores this chance. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_NaturalSpawnTotalWeight_tool: Relative weight shared by all natural Halloween outfits. Sports share one pool. Set to 0 to disable these natural spawns.
Sandbox_HWE_CandyDropChancePercent_toolt: Chance for loose candy on a costumed zombie. Rolls independently of treat containers and event items. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_BagChancePercent_tooltip: Chance for a treat container on a costumed zombie. Rolls independently of loose candy and event items. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_CollectibleContainerChancePe: Within the treat-container roll, chance to use an enabled Cat Pail, Ghost Bucket or Witch Cauldron instead of a vanilla bag. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_BagCandyChancePercent_toolti: Chance for a dropped treat container to contain candy. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_MinBagCandy_tooltip: Minimum candy pieces added to a dropped treat container. Range: 1–5.
Sandbox_HWE_MaxBagCandy_tooltip: Maximum candy pieces added to a dropped treat container. Range: 1–5.
Sandbox_HWE_DecorationChanceOnZombiePerc: Chance for one enabled event reward on a costumed zombie, separate from candy. Default: 2 percent. Carry buckets use their separate treat-container roll.
Sandbox_HWE_CostumeBlacklist_tooltip: Choose opens a searchable costume and item picker. Disabled entries leave future event and loot rolls; existing items stay. Debug spawns remain available. Save the Sandbox Options window to apply. Legacy All disables costumes only; Items disables every reward.
Sandbox_HWE_WorldDecorationChancePercent: Chance for one enabled reward when eligible wardrobe, household or garage storage first fills during the event. Default: 3 percent. Excludes shops, vehicle trunks, carried bags, corpses and player-built crates.
Sandbox_HWE_MaxDecorationsPerContainer: Maximum event items per storage container
Sandbox_HWE_MaxDecorationsPerContainer_t: Maximum event rewards in eligible world storage. Default: 1; 0 disables storage rewards. Each fill rolls for at most one new item.
Sandbox_HWE_UseAutomaticSchedule_tooltip: Automatically start and end the event using the selected clock. Manual End closes the current occurrence; the next scheduled start still fires. Applying settings reconciles manual controls, and an active event stays on until its configured end. When unchecked, the enabled event runs continuously unless manually ended.
Sandbox_HWE_ScheduleClock_tooltip: Game time uses the in-game calendar. Real time uses server UTC wall time (this computer in single player), independent of game speed or pause. Both modes use the same start/end fields. No year is entered.
Sandbox_HWE_ScheduleStart_tooltip: Start date and time using the selected clock. Enter MM/DD HH:MM, for example 10/15 00:00. Game time uses the world calendar; Real time uses server UTC. Do not include a year. A new start rearms the schedule; Manual End closes only the current occurrence. An active event remains on until its configured end.
Sandbox_HWE_ScheduleEnd_tooltip: End date and time using the selected clock. Real time ends at HH:MM:00 in server UTC; Game time uses the world calendar and includes the end minute. An end before the start crosses New Year. Do not include a year.
Sandbox_HWE_IRLStart_tooltip: Real-time start in server UTC (this computer in single player). Enter MM/DD HH:MM in 24-hour time, with no year. On Dec 25, 01/03 starts Jan 3 of the following year. A newly configured start catches up if inside its event window. Manual End or Clean Slate closes that occurrence; saving unchanged settings does not restart it. Future starts fire normally, independent of game speed or pause.
Sandbox_HWE_IRLEnd_tooltip: Real-time end in server UTC (this computer in single player). Enter MM/DD HH:MM in 24-hour time, with no year. The event ends at the start of that minute: 20:29 means 20:29:00 UTC. The end belongs to the same event window; if earlier than its start, it falls in the following year. The server catches up to the current window when it starts.
Sandbox_HWE_EventStartMessage_tooltip: Start message shown with Halloween audio once per player account for each event activation. Online players receive it immediately; unseen players receive it five real seconds after loading in while the event remains active. Seen announcements do not replay after reconnecting or server restart. The orange banner lasts 15 real seconds, can be dragged with left click or closed with X, and wraps to three lines. Longer text remains in game chat. Blank text uses the default message.
Sandbox_HWE_EventEndMessage_tooltip: Message and end stinger sent to connected players when the active event ends, for either schedule clock or a manual end. Uses the same draggable orange banner and game chat, lasting 15 real seconds. Blank text uses the default message. Players joining while the event is inactive do not receive an old end announcement.
